changeSet.author: Irina
changeSet.sql: CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW mv_user_analytics AS SELECT u.id_natural_user AS id_natural_user, COALESCE(AVG(t.experience), 0.0)::real AS prefered_complexity, u.top_task_category AS top_task_category, COALESCE(SUM(t.duration), 0.0)::real AS task_experience_hours, MAX(d.full_date) AS last_activity_date, COALESCE(AVG(t.budget), 0.0)::real AS average_payment FROM fact_user f JOIN d_user u ON f.user_key = u.user_key JOIN d_task t ON f.task_key = t.task_key JOIN d_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key GROUP BY u.id_natural_user, u.top_task_category;

rollback.sql: DROP MATERIALIZED VIEW IF EXISTS mv_user_analytics;
